name: ET Rating v2
description: Individual performance rating combining PCS stats + proximity analytics. Inspired by HLTV 2.0, Valorant ACS, PandaSkill, TrueSkill2, and competitive ET stopwatch format (class-based, objective-sequential, respawn). Format-agnostic: works in 3v3 (medic/engi/covy) and 6v6 (full roster). v2.1: published rating is sample-size shrunk toward the pool mean (Bayesian pseudo-count prior), so a handful of hot rounds no longer outranks a thousand-round track record.
formula: raw = constant + sum(weight_i * percentile(metric_i)); ET_Rating = (n * raw + shrinkage_k * pool_mean) / (n + shrinkage_k)

metrics.revive_rate: Revives given per round (medic = default class in 3v3)
metrics.survival_rate: Fraction of round time spent alive
metrics.kill_quality: Kill Quality Index — gib-weighted outcome avg (simplified KIS proxy: gibbed=1.3, tapped=1.0, revived=0.5)
metrics.crossfire_rate: Crossfire kills / total kills — team coordination frequency
metrics.trade_rate: Trade kills / total kills — avenging teammate deaths within 3s
metrics.kill_permanence: Gib rate — permanent kills / total kill outcomes
metrics.clutch_factor: Low HP (<30) or outnumbered kills / total kills
metrics.spawn_timing_eff: Avg spawn timing score — how well-timed kills are vs enemy respawn waves

normalization: Percentile rank (0.0 = worst, 1.0 = best) against all rated players
